messages:
riel: Hi all, new hire here. Trying to finish cloud setup but hitting a few blocks: can't create a service account in my GCP project (403), and creating a GKE cluster in asia-southeast1 fails with region restriction. Also no billing account visible to link. Any pointers on who to grant what?

jun: welcome @riel! can you paste the exact gcloud error for the SA creation and the cluster create?

riel: SA error: 
```
ERROR: (gcloud.iam.service-accounts.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission iam.serviceAccounts.create denied on project 123456789012.
Details: Policy 'constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation' is enforced at folder level.
```
Cluster error: 
```
ERROR: The project is not allowed to create resources in region asia-southeast1 (org policy restrictRegions)
```
Plus when I try Billing -> Link a billing account it says I don't have permission to link billing.

tara: Looks like two org policies: one blocks SA key creation and another locks allowed regions. New hires normally get a project in folder `onboarding-temp` which allows us/eu for now. What folder is your project in?

riel: It was created under my personal onboarding folder, id unknown. Project number 123456789012.

ops: Filed ticket INFRA-9054 to move the project to onboarding-temp and link billingAccounts/9999-8888-7777. I'll also add `roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin` to your user so you can create SAs for onboarding tasks. ETA ~45m.

infra-bot: Org policy scan: project 123456789012 denies service account key creation and limits compute regions to [us-west1, europe-west1]. Ticket INFRA-9054 created and assigned to ops.

riel: Thanks. One more for AWS: I don't see the rdw-terraform role in AWS SSO to switch into. When I try terraform apply it fails because backend assumes role. Who approves SSO groups?

sso-bot: Please submit an SSO request with target role arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/rdw-terraform and include your okta email. Typical approvers are infra-approvers group. If your Okta account lacks `infra-dev` group you need Okta request first.

jun: @ops when you have a sec, can you also ensure the Okta group mapping includes `infra-dev` for riel so SSO request auto-approves?

ops: Noted. Updating INFRA-9054 with Okta action: add `infra-dev` to riel and link SSO request REQ-67211. I'll follow up when done.

riel: Submitted SSO request REQ-67211 and updated the ticket. Appreciate the help!

tara: tagging as onboarding-tracked. once INFRA-9054 and REQ-67211 done, ping here and we'll close. :shipit:
